legacy_cells.S: How are routinely collected demographic, clinical, and symptom variables associated with AHI and ODI severity in adults undergoing diagnostic polysomnography?
legacy_cells.T: Adults aged ≥18 years with suspected sleep-related breathing disorders and complete polysomnographic data, evaluated at the University Hospital of Larissa, Greece, 2006–2023.
legacy_cells.AI: Demographic variables; clinical variables; symptom-related variables
legacy_cells.FX: Complete extracted PDF, pp. 1–13: title/byline and abstract (p. 1); introduction (pp. 1–3); methods and data/cohort/statistical analysis (pp. 3–5); Tables 1–3 (pp. 4, 5, 7); results (pp. 5–7); discussion (pp. 7–10); limitations and conclusions (pp. 10–11); declarations and references (pp. 11–13). | Codex audit: title/byline, abstract/conclusion, targeted methods/results and cross-check of prior quotations against extracted full text. This is a targeted audit, not an independent re-extraction of every negative/unreported field.
legacy_cells.FZ: Tables 1–3 have degraded/misaligned row and column extraction, so no table-only numerical findings were transcribed; prose methods and results were readable. The paper reports retrospective regression associations, not a patient-state transition model, action-conditioned rollout, counterfactual comparison, or planning/control result. The authors state that decision rules, external validation, and prospective implementation/evaluation are not yet available (PDF pp. 10–11). Evidence QA: 11/16 populated fields had a <=25-word quotation matching extracted PDF text (68.8%). Confidence is conservative; review this row where exact quote checks were incomplete. Codex audit: 14 prior populated fields have a located source quotation; 2 have quotations not located by normalized text matching. Unlocated quotations are review flags, not proof that the value is false. Companion evidence audit lists affected columns. Reviewer FS/FT/FU mappings are synthesis. Prior unsupported/missing fields remain Not reported; no clinical benefit inferred from offline simulation.

limitations: All13 pages including46 references and all3 tables/2figures reviewed; no independent human review.
No readiness facet established: retrospective data and in-sample fit do not meet R2 held-out evaluation; no stated split, external validation or prospective utility.
Table1 hypertension425/445 and COPD67/68 totals conflict.
Claimed calibration not displayed and refers to baseline Table2. Posterior coefficient intervals do not establish calibrated patient-level risk or causal effects.
